questions.q: A polythene rod is rubbed with a cloth and becomes negatively charged. Why?
options: electrons move from the cloth to the rod
protons move from the rod to the cloth
electrons move from the rod to the cloth
protons move from the cloth to the rod
questions.why: Charging by friction only transfers electrons; the rod gains electrons, so it is negative.
